source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.9 and Example 17.5 (PDF 98).

blocks.text: AC circuit mein current ke raste ki total opposition (kul rukawat) ko impedance Z kehte hain. Is mein resistance R aur reactance X dono shamil hain. Resistance R resistors ki opposition (rukawat) hai. Reactance capacitors (capacitive reactance X_C) aur inductors (inductive reactance X_L) ki opposition hai. Sirf resistor wale circuit mein sirf R hoti hai, reactance nahi.

blocks.title: Impedance
blocks.text: Aise circuits mein resistance aur reactances ka combined effect (mila jula asar) impedance kehlata hai.
Yeh rms voltage aur rms current ka ratio (nisbat) hai:
Impedance ki SI unit ohm hai.
R, L aur C par voltages in phase nahi hote, is liye resistance aur reactance ko seedha jama nahi kar sakte; inhein vectors (phasors) ki tarah add karte (jorte) hain, jaisa agle topics mein hai.

blocks.title: Example 17.5
blocks.problem: Ek AC circuit ka peak voltage 200 V aur peak current 10 A hai. Circuit ki impedance nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: Vₒ = 200 V, Iₒ = 10 A
blocks.answer: Z = 20 Ω (Vₒ/Iₒ = 200/10 se bhi yahi aata hai)

blocks.prompt: Impedance nikalte waqt resistance aur reactance ko seedha jama kyun nahi karte?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke resistor aur reactance par voltages mein 90° ka phase farq hai; inhein vectors ki tarah jorna parta hai (Pythagoras se: Z = √(R² + X²)).

items: Impedance Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ: R aur X ki kul opposition, ohm mein.
R aur X vectors ki tarah jurte hain, seedhe jama nahi hote.
